article.hook: Idealism shows up where you least expect it: behind schedules, budgets, and meetings. Neptune in Capricorn is silently sketching grand visions on the backs of spreadsheets and boardroom agendas.
article.lived: This transit stretches over more than a decade, shaping a generation that imagines big not by escaping but by building. We notice it when someone’s relentless focus on a project is fueled less by duty and more by a quiet, persistent hope. It’s the person planning a career pivot with a spreadsheet that doubles as a daydream map.
article.turn: The line blurs when imagination hardens into cold calculation or when ambition masks avoidance. People retreat into work so deep they forget why they started. The dream dies in the details when the ideal becomes a checkbox to tick rather than a fire to feed.
moves: Draft a plan that includes what you want, not just what you need.
Schedule a conversation where you admit what you’re avoiding.
Prototype an idea that feels too big to fit into your usual routine.
